products.name: Neo Destiny Booster Box
products.note: Unlimited box, 36 packs of 11 cards (TCGplayer 563755 and the 1st Edition box 563754 text, PSA 9498). TCGplayer lists it without a price, so it is priced at 36 packs. The pack price is TCGplayer's single Unlimited listing ($1,610.00); there is no market price.

products.name: Theme Deck "Light"
products.note: A 60-card Water and Fighting deck with a holo Light Azumarill (Neo Destiny 13), the deck's featured card, plus a metal Lugia coin and markers (not simulated). List: Bulbapedia 'Light (TCG)' and PokeBeach's Neo Destiny theme-deck page. TCGplayer text: '1 60-card pre-constructed deck, damage counters, 1 coin'.
